takes.text: The oceans are sliding toward the equator.
A spinning planet pushes water outward, toward the equator, exactly as it pushes you.
At a twelve hour day the sea wants to stand about twenty miles higher at the equator.
The ocean is only about two point three miles deep.
So it drains toward a belt around the equator, and the poles dry out.
A rough first guess, but the direction is certain: land near the poles emerges, and your own coast floods.
And the weather is about to change completely.
Part four of eight. Full video on YouTube.
